title: Signal: conda channel configured over cleartext
scope: A environment.yml file that declares a channel URL that uses cleartext http.
limitations: It matches a channel URL that uses cleartext http in the parsed environment.yml; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A environment.yml that mentions a channel URL that uses cleartext http in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
